from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.types import DecimalType, IntegerType, StringType, ArrayType


def transform(df):
    """Clean cost and SLA fields and append their quality flags."""
    cost_raw = F.trim(F.col("cost"))
    sla_raw = F.trim(F.col("sla_hours"))
    cost_token = F.upper(cost_raw).isin("", "NULL", "N/A", "TBD")
    sla_token = F.upper(sla_raw).isin("", "NULL", "N/A")

    # try_cast returns null rather than raising on malformed or overflowing input.
    cost_num = F.expr("try_cast(trim(`cost`) AS DECIMAL(38,18))")
    sla_syntax_ok = sla_raw.rlike(r"^[+-]?[0-9]+$")
    sla_num = F.expr("try_cast(trim(`sla_hours`) AS BIGINT)")
    int_min, int_max = -2147483648, 2147483647

    cost_missing = cost_token
    cost_invalid = (~cost_token) & (
        cost_num.isNull() | (cost_num < F.lit(0)) |
        F.expr("try_cast(trim(`cost`) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) IS NULL")
    )
    sla_missing = sla_token
    sla_invalid = (~sla_token) & (
        (~sla_syntax_ok) | sla_num.isNull() |
        (sla_num < F.lit(int_min)) | (sla_num > F.lit(int_max))
    )
    sla_confirm = (~sla_missing) & (~sla_invalid) & sla_num.isin(0, 999)

    if "quality_flags" in df.columns:
        prior = F.coalesce(
            F.col("quality_flags"), F.array().cast(ArrayType(StringType()))
        )
    else:
        prior = F.array().cast(ArrayType(StringType()))

    additions = F.concat(
        F.when(cost_missing, F.array(F.lit("cost_missing"))).otherwise(F.array()),
        F.when(cost_invalid, F.array(F.lit("cost_invalid"))).otherwise(F.array()),
        F.when(sla_missing, F.array(F.lit("sla_missing"))).otherwise(F.array()),
        F.when(sla_invalid, F.array(F.lit("sla_invalid"))).otherwise(F.array()),
        F.when(sla_confirm, F.array(F.lit("sla_requires_confirmation"))).otherwise(F.array())
    )

    return (
        df.withColumn(
            "cost",
            F.when(cost_missing | cost_invalid, F.lit(None).cast(DecimalType(18, 2)))
             .otherwise(F.expr("try_cast(trim(`cost`) AS DECIMAL(18,2))"))
        )
        .withColumn(
            "sla_hours",
            F.when(sla_missing | sla_invalid, F.lit(None).cast(IntegerType()))
             .otherwise(sla_num.cast(IntegerType()))
        )
        .withColumn("quality_flags", F.concat(prior, additions))
    )

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.types import ArrayType, DecimalType, IntegerType, StringType


def transform(df):
    """Clean cost and SLA values and append their quality flags."""
    cost_raw = F.trim(F.col("cost"))
    cost_text = F.trim(F.regexp_replace(cost_raw, r"^\$\s*", ""))
    sla_raw = F.trim(F.col("sla_hours"))

    cost_missing = F.coalesce(
        cost_raw.isNull() | F.upper(cost_raw).isin("", "NULL", "N/A", "TBD"),
        F.lit(False),
    )
    sla_missing = F.coalesce(
        sla_raw.isNull() | F.upper(sla_raw).isin("", "NULL", "N/A"),
        F.lit(False),
    )

    cost_num = F.expr(
        "try_cast(trim(regexp_replace(trim(`cost`), '^\\$\\s*', '')) AS DECIMAL(18,2))"
    )
    cost_unrounded = F.expr(
        "try_cast(trim(regexp_replace(trim(`cost`), '^\\$\\s*', '')) AS DECIMAL(38,18))"
    )
    # Inspect digits beyond the cents position; only nonzero excess digits invalidate.
    cost_excess = F.regexp_replace(
        cost_text, r"^[+-]?[0-9]+\.[0-9]{0,2}", ""
    )
    cost_extra_nonzero = cost_text.rlike(r"^[+-]?[0-9]+\.[0-9]{3,}$") & cost_excess.rlike(r"[1-9]")
    cost_invalid = F.coalesce(
        (~cost_missing) & (
            cost_num.isNull()
            | cost_unrounded.isNull()
            | (cost_unrounded < F.lit(0))
            | cost_extra_nonzero
        ),
        F.lit(False),
    )

    sla_syntax_ok = sla_raw.rlike(r"^[+-]?[0-9]+$")
    sla_num = F.expr("try_cast(trim(`sla_hours`) AS BIGINT)")
    sla_invalid = F.coalesce(
        (~sla_missing) & (
            (~sla_syntax_ok)
            | sla_num.isNull()
            | (sla_num < F.lit(0))
            | (sla_num > F.lit(2147483647))
        ),
        F.lit(False),
    )
    sla_confirm = F.coalesce(
        (~sla_missing) & (~sla_invalid) & sla_num.isin(0, 999), F.lit(False)
    )

    if "quality_flags" in df.columns:
        prior = F.coalesce(
            F.col("quality_flags"),
            F.array().cast(ArrayType(StringType())),
        )
    else:
        prior = F.array().cast(ArrayType(StringType()))

    additions = F.concat(
        F.when(cost_missing, F.array(F.lit("cost_missing"))).otherwise(F.array()),
        F.when(cost_invalid, F.array(F.lit("cost_invalid"))).otherwise(F.array()),
        F.when(sla_missing, F.array(F.lit("sla_missing"))).otherwise(F.array()),
        F.when(sla_invalid, F.array(F.lit("sla_invalid"))).otherwise(F.array()),
        F.when(sla_confirm, F.array(F.lit("sla_requires_confirmation"))).otherwise(F.array()),
    )

    # All expressions above reference original input columns; do not chain replacements.
    replacements = {
        "cost": F.when(cost_missing | cost_invalid, F.lit(None).cast(DecimalType(18, 2)))
        .otherwise(cost_num).alias("cost"),
        "sla_hours": F.when(sla_missing | sla_invalid, F.lit(None).cast(IntegerType()))
        .otherwise(sla_num.cast(IntegerType())).alias("sla_hours"),
        "quality_flags": F.concat(prior, additions).alias("quality_flags"),
    }
    return df.select(*[
        replacements.get(name, F.col(name)) for name in df.columns
    ] if "quality_flags" in df.columns else [
        *[replacements.get(name, F.col(name)) for name in df.columns],
        replacements["quality_flags"],
    ])

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.types import ArrayType, StringType


def transform(df):
    """Normalize cost and SLA values and append their quality flags."""
    cost_raw = F.trim(F.col("cost"))
    cost_text = F.trim(F.regexp_replace(cost_raw, r"^\\$\\s*", ""))
    sla_text = F.trim(F.col("sla_hours"))

    cost_missing = F.coalesce(
        cost_raw.isNull() | F.upper(cost_raw).isin("", "NULL", "N/A", "TBD"), F.lit(False)
    )
    sla_missing = F.coalesce(
        sla_text.isNull() | F.upper(sla_text).isin("", "NULL", "N/A"), F.lit(False)
    )

    cost_syntax = cost_text.rlike(r"^[+-]?(?:[0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]*)?|\\.[0-9]+)$")
    cost_num = cost_text.try_cast("decimal(18,2)")
    excess = F.regexp_extract(cost_text, r"\\.(?:[0-9]{0,2})([0-9]+)$", 1)
    excess_nonzero = excess.rlike(r"[1-9]")
    # Check the original digits so tiny negatives such as -0.001 are not rounded to zero.
    negative_nonzero = cost_text.rlike(r"^-") & F.regexp_replace(cost_text, r"[^0-9]", "").rlike(r"[1-9]")
    cost_invalid = F.coalesce(
        (~cost_missing) & (
            (~cost_syntax) | cost_num.isNull() | negative_nonzero | excess_nonzero
        ), F.lit(False)
    )

    sla_syntax = sla_text.rlike(r"^[+-]?[0-9]+$")
    sla_num = sla_text.try_cast("bigint")
    sla_invalid = F.coalesce(
        (~sla_missing) & (
            (~sla_syntax) | sla_num.isNull() | (sla_num < 0) | (sla_num > 2147483647)
        ), F.lit(False)
    )
    sla_confirm = F.coalesce(
        (~sla_missing) & (~sla_invalid) & sla_num.isin(0, 999), F.lit(False)
    )

    empty_flags = F.array().cast(ArrayType(StringType()))
    def flag(condition, name):
        return F.when(condition, F.array(F.lit(name))).otherwise(empty_flags)

    additions = F.concat(
        flag(cost_missing, "cost_missing"), flag(cost_invalid, "cost_invalid"),
        flag(sla_missing, "sla_missing"), flag(sla_invalid, "sla_invalid"),
        flag(sla_confirm, "sla_requires_confirmation"),
    )
    prior = (F.coalesce(F.col("quality_flags"), empty_flags)
             if "quality_flags" in df.columns else empty_flags)
    replacements = {
        "cost": F.when(cost_missing | cost_invalid, F.lit(None).cast("decimal(18,2)"))
                 .otherwise(cost_num).alias("cost"),
        "sla_hours": F.when(sla_missing | sla_invalid, F.lit(None).cast("int"))
                      .otherwise(sla_num.cast("int")).alias("sla_hours"),
        "quality_flags": F.concat(prior, additions).alias("quality_flags"),
    }
    projection = [replacements.get(name, F.col(name)) for name in df.columns]
    if "quality_flags" not in df.columns:
        projection.append(replacements["quality_flags"])
    return df.select(*projection)

feedback: The raw Python regex literals in the last draft are overescaped: doubled backslashes match literal backslashes. Avoid backslashes entirely by using character classes. Dollar-prefix pattern can be ^[$] * . Monetary syntax can use ^[+-]?(?:[0-9]+(?:[.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)$ . Excess fraction extraction can use [.][0-9]{0,2}([0-9]+)$ . Keep cost_text.try_cast, negative-original-digit checks, null handling and single projection. Check the intended regex matching mentally on $12.50, 12.50, .001, -0.001 and 0.
